population: 17 and 25 primate species; human allele state and frequency from the 1000 Genomes Project
conclusion: Reports BRD8 p.Q1198R (this variant) as one of 25 parallel amino-acid changes shared by three long-lived primate species. It states no human longevity association: the alternate allele is at 0.97 in the 1000 Genomes Project and the change is called tolerated by SIFT and benign by PolyPhen2. The authors also conclude the 25 parallel changes were not extreme against their own resampling null, while the 25-gene set was enriched for previously aging-related genes (empirical p = 6e-04). Cited by PMID 41057961 as a prior longevity association; it does not support that reading for this variant in humans.
study_design: comparative phylogenetic genome-phenome analysis across primate species
statistical_test: none for this variant; the paper's test is a 10,000-permutation bootstrap enrichment over the 25-gene set
